name: en_to_ja_word
description: 2-shot English->Japanese word translation (common nouns). Control: Japanese->English with same pairs.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
LANG="Japanese"
base=["house","water","book","dog","cat","tree","city","school","bread","sun","moon","friend","car","door","window","river","mountain","apple","milk","fish","bird","flower","night","king","hand","heart","money","work","food","sea"]
tr=["家","水","本","犬","猫","木","都市","学校","パン","太陽","月","友達","車","ドア","窓","川","山","りんご","牛乳","魚","鳥","花","夜","王","手","心","お金","仕事","食べ物","海"]
words=list(zip(base,tr));items=[];ctrl=[]
for en,t in words:
    others=[w for w in words if w[0]!=en]
    for rep in range(4):
        shots=random.sample(others,2)
        items.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {a}\n{LANG}: {b}\n\n" for a,b in shots)+f"English: {en}\n{LANG}:","answer":" "+t})
        ctrl.append({"prompt":"".join(f"{LANG}: {b}\nEnglish: {a}\n\n" for a,b in shots)+f"{LANG}: {t}\nEnglish:","answer":" "+en})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False)
